gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, at 3 hours of gaming a day, the Keychron K3 HE's tested 27 h with backlight on lasts about 9 days per charge and its 55 h with backlight off lasts about 18 days, while the Logitech G915 X LIGHTSPEED TKL is rated for about 14 days at 100% RGB and about 333 days with RGB off.
standout_why: geekgamingtricks.com (2026-10-28) names the K3 HE best wireless HE board but gives only Keychron's '55-hour' lab claim, with no backlight-on figure. gamingkeyboards.net (2026-07-13) does not cover the K3 HE or G915 X and says only that RGB cuts battery life. It gives no per-condition hours and no days-per-charge figure. I could not read the cited RTINGS low-profile list or the Tom's Hardware wireless list: WebFetch returned only navigation and the page title. So I cannot rule out that they give rated battery hours, but neither returned a days-per-charge derivation.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's split: the wired-only NuPhy Air75 HE for competitive FPS. It changes how the wireless pick should be framed. The $119.99 K3 HE is the only wireless board in the set with magnetic switches and Rapid Trigger, but it needs charging about every 9 gaming days with the backlight on (Notebookcheck test) and about every 18 days with it off. The $209.99 G915 X TKL uses ordinary GL switches with no Rapid Trigger, but it runs about 14 days lit and close to a year dark at 3 h/day. Buyers who want wireless and rarely want to charge should get the Logitech. Buyers who want Rapid Trigger without a cable should accept charging the K3 HE weekly or every other week.
